question: Which of the following numbers divides 159916901?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given number is 159916901, which is an odd number.

An odd number can never be perfectly divided by even numbers, so options 18 and 28 are eliminated.

Its last two digits are 01, which means it is not divisible by 25 (as 25 requires the last two digits to be 00, 25, 50, or 75).

Thus, by the simple process of elimination, the number must be divisible by 19.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number to be divided = 159916901

**Checking the given options:**

⇒ Option 1: 25

⇒ Since the last two digits of 159916901 are 01, it is not divisible by 25.

⇒ Option 3: 28

⇒ 28 is an even number, and 159916901 is an odd number. Hence, it is not divisible by 28.

⇒ Option 4: 18

⇒ 18 is an even number, so it cannot perfectly divide an odd number.

⇒ Option 2: 19

⇒ Dividing directly: 159916901 ÷ 19

⇒ 159916901 = 19 × 8416679

⇒ The remainder is 0, indicating perfect divisibility.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 19

Multiply the last digit of the number by 2 and add it to the remaining truncated number. If the resulting sum is divisible by 19, then the original number is also divisible by 19.

Divisibility Rule of 25

A number is completely divisible by 25 only if its last two digits are exactly 00, 25, 50, or 75.

Divisibility Rule of Even Numbers

An even number will always have an even unit digit (0, 2, 4, 6, 8). Moreover, an even number can never perfectly divide any odd number as 2 will never be a prime factor of the odd number.
